== Notes ==
* Fragility only triggers when the target receives a new condition. Reapplying already applied conditions doesn't trigger Fragility.
* Casting Fragility while under the effect of [[Glyph of Immolation]] will cause the burning condition to be applied before Fragility, causing Fragility to not trigger. 
* Synergizes well with [[Virulence]], even with low [[Death Magic]] attribute.
